text:
anya: Heads-up: I'm proposing a tiny RBAC scope change so the new event-relay can read keystore event-metadata. needs quick review because KMS audit and SAST gate are in scope.
raj: what's the minimum perms we need? can we restrict by attribute and time window? :eyes:
anya: yes — only `keystore.events.read` and only for `env=canary` tag. TTL 72h for the service account token.
olivia: SAST flagged a serializer that may include env-derived strings — link: scans/789. we should patch before adding wide access.
security-bot: SAST: high 'config-injection' in repo redwood/relay at relay/serializer.py:42. https://scans.internal/789
anya: propose quick mitigations: 1) apply RBAC restricted to canary region, 2) add runtime redaction toggle, 3) require PR to include audit-log smoke output.
oncall: rollback plan: revoke role, stop relay, create incident INC-888. collect last 500 events for forensic export.
raj: I'll own the canary deploy and run the audit query: `gcloud logging read "jsonPayload.stream=\"keystore\"" --project=redwood-canary | jq` and grep for (secret|password|key).
olivia: I'll review suppression requests and require unit tests proving redaction.
anya: ETA canary in 2h, will post results here.
